title: The Mystery of the Missing Key
description: Four recordings about a missing school key: a worried boy, an announcement, a detective chat and a happy ending.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A big problem
parts.intro: You will hear Tom telling Anna about a problem.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Tom, you look worried. What's the matter?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: I can't find the key to the music room. Mrs Lee gave it to me this morning because I'm the class helper.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: When did you last have it?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: After the art lesson. I put it in my jacket pocket. But now the pocket is empty!

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Did you look in your bag?

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Yes, twice. I looked under my desk and in the playground, too. Nothing.

script.speaker: Anna
script.text: Don't worry. I'll help you look. Maybe it fell out when you played football.

script.speaker: Tom
script.text: Maybe. The key is silver, and it has a blue ribbon on it.

parts.title: Part 2 · A school announcement
parts.intro: You will hear Mrs Lee making an announcement.

script.speaker: Mrs Lee
script.text: Good afternoon, students. This is Mrs Lee with an important message. The key to the music room is missing.

script.speaker: Mrs Lee
script.text: It is a small silver key with a blue ribbon. Tom last saw it on Tuesday, after the art lesson, at about one o'clock.

script.speaker: Mrs Lee
script.text: We need this key because the choir practice is on Friday. Without it, we can't get into the room.

script.speaker: Mrs Lee
script.text: Please look carefully in your classrooms, in the playground and in the sports hall.

script.speaker: Mrs Lee
script.text: If you find it, bring it to the school office. The person who finds it will get a free ticket to the school show. Thank you!

parts.title: Part 3 · Asking the caretaker
parts.intro: You will hear Mai asking the school caretaker, Mr Dan, some questions.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Excuse me, Mr Dan. Did you see a silver key with a blue ribbon on Tuesday?

script.speaker: Mr Dan
script.text: No, I didn't, but I saw a boy with a red cap near the music room at about one o'clock.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: A boy? Do you know who he was?

script.speaker: Mr Dan
script.text: I'm not sure. Actually, it wasn't a boy. It was the cleaner, Mr Bao, and he wears a red cap every day.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Oh, I see. Did he have a key?

script.speaker: Mr Dan
script.text: He has a big bunch of keys, but they are all gold. And he was carrying a bucket.

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: Thank you. Wait, what's that noise under the stairs?

script.speaker: Mr Dan
script.text: Oh, that's Max, the school dog. He sleeps there in the afternoon.

parts.title: Part 4 · The mystery is solved
parts.intro: You will hear Kim telling a story about how the key was found.

script.speaker: Kim
script.text: On Thursday morning, Mai and I went to look under the stairs. Max was asleep in his basket, and we could see something blue under his blanket.

script.speaker: Kim
script.text: It was the ribbon! The key was inside the blanket. Max had picked it up from the playground because he liked the ribbon.

script.speaker: Kim
script.text: Tom's jacket had a hole in the pocket, and that was how the key fell out on Tuesday. He felt very silly.

script.speaker: Kim
script.text: We ran to the office. Mrs Lee was so happy that she gave both of us tickets to the school show.

script.speaker: Kim
script.text: Now Tom keeps the key on a string around his neck. And Max? He got a new blue ribbon of his own!
